sensors.$comment: diagonalToleranceDeg is a misnomer: it controls the half-width of the acceptance window around the requested principal-axis orientation (vertical here, diagonal elsewhere). At 16x16 native rendered upsteam to 1024px and back, the 4x4 grid model regularly hits 86-87° instead of dead 90°, so we accept ±5° around vertical. Sensor tightening is a separate axis from prompt strictness — the prompt still asks for 'perfectly vertical'.
